enumeration.method: Independent bold-heading enumeration and visual comparison of all ten complete statements.

source_notes.note: Registered source is arXiv2206.08756v3 marked15Jan2024,65pages, submitted-to-AoS preprint. Main text ends with acknowledgements on page26 before REFERENCES y328.151; clip322. All supplementary bodies, starting32, are excluded. No assumption of identity with the published version is made.

Theorem2 prints2^(-2^t) for all t≥0, even without noise. At t=0 it implies e0≤e0/2 unless e0=0. The corresponding Corollary1 RGN factor has the same issue. Preserve the original; do not repair the exponent or shift the time range.

Theorem4’s upper expected error uses unstarred X although the surrounding true parameter is X*. Its lower bound deliberately ranges over X. Preserve the difference in the inventory; no silent star insertion.
Theorem8 prints bar-p=max_{k=1,...,d+m} p_i, with mismatched indices. Its df is sum p_i, not the exact rank-one manifold dimension; retain both source expressions.

Section5 preceding14 prints ||X*||F+sigma²=1, without a square on the norm. Equation14 instead sets X*=sqrt(1-sigma²) x* tensor-power d with unit-norm Rademacher x*, consistent with squared-norm normalization. Preserve both. A common random planted signal couples samples under H1, so the source iid wording is naturally conditional on that signal; explicit independence of the planted signal, designs and errors is not fully spelled out in14.

Theorem9 bounds the alternative expectation of null-centered, null-unit-variance polynomials of total degree at mostD. It does not prove an unconditional lower bound for all polynomial-time algorithms. The surrounding runtime equivalence is conjectural and the testing-to-estimation reduction is in an excluded supplement. Preserve the bound n≤(p/(dD))^(d/2)delta/[2(1-sigma²)] and variance of f, not f squared.

Detailed matricization/mode-product indexing and explicit tangent-space parameterization are deferred to SupplementB. Main-text formulas and dimensions are saved. Admissible nonempty Tucker ranks, singular-value ties and rank-deficient QR choices require conventions beyond the printed definitions; do not silently import an appendix.

Definition1 states1≤r_k≤p_k, whereas later constants use2r and2r+r*. Best-approximation subspaces also use ranks2r. A capping/extension convention may be needed when these exceed ambient sizes; the source does not specify it in these passages.

Stepsize6 is0/0 at zero projected gradient unless a stopping or zero-step convention is supplied. Algorithm1 Eq8 prints the2-norm for tensor responses, while the surrounding objective, Lemma2 and Section7 use Frobenius norm. Preserve the print; vectorization equivalence is an interpretation, not a source rewrite.

T-HOSVD/ST-HOSVD pseudocode lies in excluded Algorithms6/7. Main Algorithms2–5 consistently print old superscript0 factors both for j<k and j>k; do not change them to sequential updated factors. Matrix P_r is explicitly defined in the main text and does not need the excluded tensor-retraction pseudocode.

Section4.4 introduces rank-one factors and amplitude lambda without explicitly restating unit norms for each u_k; the earlier least-nonzero-singular-value lambda convention suggests normalization but does not state each factor norm here. Algorithm3 uses R_A inverse, requiring full column rank, and Algorithm4 uses even n and two sample halves. These requirements remain documented separately from original theorem wording.

Theorems5–8 print log and loglog iteration thresholds truncated with vee0, using division by sigma and positive signal strength. At sigma=0 or where the inner logarithm is nonpositive, an extended/domain convention is needed; the max with0 does not itself define an undefined log. No corrective convention is inserted.

T5/T6/T8 reference T1/T2 initialization conditions as guaranteed conclusions; T7 similarly references Corollary1. They do not assume the initializer is already good. T4 references the qualified estimator of T3 only in its upper branch; the minimax lower bound quantifies all estimators. T10 supplies a proof tool for T5/T6, but their theorem statements do not import its perturbation hypothesis.

recorded_checks: Exactly ten complete main-text Theorems1–10, independently enumerated by bold headings and compared visually, including every branch and printed title. Main text ends before references onpage26; supplementary bodies are excluded.

Thirty source entries and ten auxiliary passages preserve regression/contraction, tensor rank and operations, geometry, TRIP, Gaussian design, separate RGD/RGN branches, initialization Algorithms2–4, testing distributions14 and deterministic OHOOI Algorithm5. Full Algorithm1 remains separately archived.

Independent reconstruction verifies71 direct uses and115 related connections. RGN-only T2 has no RGD stepsize or additional RGD hypothesis. Matrix T7 uses P_r and does not inherit tensor-only retractions. Testing T9 has only its own hypothesis-test entry. Deterministic T10 has no regression/Gaussian/TRIP dependency.

T5/T6/T8 initialization references and T7 Corollary1 references are guaranteed output properties, not input assumptions. T4’s qualified-estimator reference applies to its upper branch, not its lower minimax infimum. T10 proof references from T5/T6 and Hermite calculations for T9 do not add statement dependencies.

Thirteen notes preserve the RGN time-zero factor, unstarred expected-error target, dimension-index mismatch, unsquared testing normalization and conditional coupling, deferred supplement definitions, rank-range and rank-deficient conventions, zero line-search/logarithm domains, tensor2-norm print, update order and missing explicit rank-one factor normalization.

Every entry has literal author terminology, meaningful source highlights and preserved source kind. All115 related connections have local paths and source-specific explanations. No mathlib availability or proof-correctness claim is made.

All six contentJSON files reproduce byte for byte in a fresh empty directory. Seven retained scripts cover inventory, extraction, context, finalization, rebuilding and independent review. Rebuilding reproduces saved decisions; it is not a new semantic source review.
